derivedEstimator.scope: Independent sampling-variance derivation for the source-proposed Richardson observable estimator; toy model only, not measured hardware.
samplingAssumptions: Independent shot estimates at distinct noise scales
Unbiased per-scale sample means for the actual noisy observable
Known, correctly implemented noise scaling for the bias-cancellation statement
Equal per-shot variance of 1 only for the illustrative shot-budget comparison; not asserted for real devices
Fixed total shot budget does not include circuit-time or calibration overhead
derivedEstimator.resultQualification: Linear truncation bias cancels under the assumed expansion but quadratic-and-higher bias, independent measurement variance, correlated drift, calibration errors and model mismatch remain.
